Charging##state: Status shown on the car right now: the battery is being charged at this moment.
Charging##value: Value reported by the car for its charging state: charging at this moment.
Charging: Noun: the activity of charging, as a tab, card heading or timeline segment.
Driving##state: Status chip: the car is on the road right now.
Driving: Noun: the activity of driving, as a tab, timeline segment or group of events.
Open##action: Button that opens a page of the app.
Open: State of a door, window or flap: it is open (not closed).
Opened: Value reported by the car: has been opened, is open.
Range##period: Label of the control that chooses the time period shown in a chart (24 hours, 7 days, ...).
To##place: Table column: the destination of a trip (where it went to).
To: End of a date or time range, next to 'From' (a filter field: until this date).
From: Start of a date or time range, or the origin of a trip in a table column.
It may have been removed.##trip: Said about a trip that does not exist (any more).
Said about a charging session that does not exist (any more).
Trunk opened##value: Value reported by the car: the trunk (boot) is open.
Ventilation##value: Value reported by the car for what the climate system is doing: it is ventilating.
Ventilation: Noun: the car's ventilation function, as a heading.
Charge: Noun: one charging session. Never a fee.
Charges: Noun, plural: charging sessions; also the navigation entry. Never fees.
Trips: Journeys by car; also the navigation entry.
State: Table column: the current status of an item. Not a country's state.
Home: The user's home as a charging location; also a kind of saved place. Not a 'home page'.
Public: Charging away from home, at a public station.
Work: Kind of saved place: the user's workplace.
Place: A saved location with a name and radius.
Places: Saved locations; also the navigation entry.
Auto: Option meaning 'decide automatically'. Not a car.
Events: Log of things that happened (to the car, or sent by a webhook). Not organised events such as concerts.
Activity: Navigation entry: the timeline of what the car did.
Locked: The car's doors or the charging cable are locked.
Connected: A connection or the charging cable is established.
Disconnected: No connection; the cable is not connected.
Disconnect: Button: remove the stored API key and stop reading the car.
Enabled: Checkbox or chip: this item is switched on.
Disabled: Chip: this item is switched off.
disabled: Table cell: this data part is switched off for the car.
unavailable: Table cell: this data part is temporarily not available.
unsupported: Table cell: the car does not have this data part.
missing: Table cell: expected but not sent.
present: Table cell: the data part was sent.
on: Value beside a label: switched on.
off: Value beside a label: switched off.
none: Value beside a label: there is none (for example no error, no parameters).
Free: Checkbox of a saved place: charging there costs nothing.
manual: Chip: the cost was entered by hand.
Manual: Value reported by the car: charge mode set to manual.
Sending: Delivery status of a webhook: being sent right now.
Waiting: Delivery status of a webhook: waiting to be sent.
Delivered: Delivery status of a webhook: arrived at the receiver.
Test: Name of the webhook test event.
Idle: Polling mode while the car is not in use. Not an engine idling.
{time} idle: Polling interval used while the car is not in use. Not an engine idling.
{time} active: Polling interval used while the car is busy (driving or charging).
inferred: Chip: Mate worked this out from other data; it did not see it happen.
estimated: Chip: a calculated estimate, not a measurement.
guess: Screen-reader word after a cost: it is a guess.
expired: Chip: a key has run out.
history only: Appended to a car's name: only its recorded history is kept; it is no longer read.
new: Import preview chip: a trip not recorded before.
completed: Import preview chip: an existing trip gets missing values added.
known: Import preview chip: already recorded, nothing changes.
new trips: Caption under a number in the import preview: trips not recorded before.
already known: Caption under a number: trips already recorded.
supported: Chip: the car supports this command.
not supported: Chip: the car does not support this command.
unknown yet: Chip: it is not known yet whether the car supports this.
Unsupported: Value reported by the car: not supported.
Invalid: Value reported by the car: not valid.
Completed: Value reported by the car: finished.
Conserving: Value reported by the car: holding the charge level to protect the battery.
Preheating: Charge or climate state: warming up in advance.
Running: Chip: a climate function or session is running.
{n} Running: Number of charging sessions still in progress.
{n} Important: Number of data-quality findings of the severity 'important'.
{n} Info: Number of data-quality findings that are only informational.
Info: Severity of a data-quality finding: for information only.
{n} changed: After a repair: number of records that were changed.
{n} reviewed: Number of data-quality checks the user has marked as reviewed.
{n} inferred: Number of charging sessions that Mate worked out rather than measured.
Reviewed: Chip or message: marked as reviewed by the user.
Review: Button: look at a data-quality finding.
Fix: Button: run the repair for a data-quality finding.
Fixed: Message after a repair, followed by a number.
Gap: Data-quality sample: a gap between recorded values, followed by a number of hours.
Findings: Label before the number of problems a data check found.
Retry: Button: send a webhook delivery again.
Merge: Button: join two trips into one.
Done at: Label before the time at which charging will be finished.
More: Navigation button that opens the rest of the menu.
Older: Button: show older entries or periods.
Newer: Button: show newer entries or periods.
View: Accessible name of the control that switches between views of a page.
Display: Settings card: how the app looks (units, language, theme).
Light: Theme option: light colour scheme. Not a lamp.
Polling: Settings card: how often Mate asks Škoda for the car's state.
Mode: A setting that chooses how something works.
Kind: Kind of a saved place (home, work, other).
Part: Table column: one part of the data the car reports.
Reason: Table column: why something is so.
Result: Table column: outcome of a command or request.
Details: Table column or button: further information.
Command: A remote command to the car.
Control: Navigation entry: remote control of the car.
Controls: Home Assistant guide: the buttons and sliders that appear there.
Overview: Navigation entry: the start page about the car.
System: Navigation entry: technical status of the app.
Capabilities: Page listing what the car and the interface can do.
Diagnostics: Page with technical data for troubleshooting.
Pages: Accessible name of the previous/next page buttons of a list.
Security: Group of webhook events about doors and windows.
Read: Group of operations that only read data. Verb used as a heading.
Endpoint: Table column: the address of an interface operation.
Healthy: Chip: the app is working normally.
Discovery: Home Assistant's MQTT Discovery setting (technical term).
End: End point or end time of a trip.
Start: Start point or start time of a trip. As a noun.
Day: One day, as the label of a weekday selection.
Week: Label before the summary of a week.
1 y: Very short chart period button: 1 year.
24 h: Very short chart period button: 24 hours.
7 d: Very short chart period button: 7 days.
30 d: Very short chart period button: 30 days.
MON: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Monday.
TUE: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Tuesday.
WED: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Wednesday.
THU: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Thursday.
FRI: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Friday.
SAT: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Saturday.
SUN: Very short weekday on a toggle button: Sunday.
Ac: Value: alternating current. Use your usual spelling (often AC).
Dc: Value: direct current. Use your usual spelling (often DC).
Maximum: Value: the highest charging current setting.
Reduced: Value: a reduced charging current setting.
Permanent: Value: always (setting for unlocking the plug).
Amber: Colour name for a place's marker.
Teal: Colour name for a place's marker.
Colour: Label of the marker colour choice.
Not found: Short error: the item was not found.
Not set: Value: the user has not entered it.
Not reported: Value: the car does not send this.
Demo: Badge: the app runs with a fictional car.
Car: Accessible name of the car picture.
Windows: The car's windows. Not the operating system.
Plug: The charging plug and cable of the car.
Visits: Times the car was at a place.
Days: Days on which the car was at a place.
Readings: Recorded answers from the car (download link).
Examples: A few of the records a data check found.
Example: Label before a calculated example price.
Preview: What an import would do, before it is run.
Imported: Heading of the result after an import.
Note: The user's own note about a trip or charging session.
Name: Name of an item.
Blocked: Chip: reading is stopped until the key is replaced.
Unplugged: Log event: the charging cable was disconnected from the car.
Plugged in: Log event: the charging cable was connected to the car.
Arrived at a place: Webhook event: the car arrived at a saved place.
Left a place: Webhook event: the car left a saved place.
{distance} range: How far the car can still drive, shown after the number.
of {total}: Caption under a number: out of this total.
and {n} more: End of a shortened list of findings.
since {date}: Continues a line: from this date or time onwards.
reported {ago}: Continues a line: when the car sent this; {ago} is a relative time such as '5 minutes ago'.
Updated {ago}: Header line; {ago} is a relative time.
ready {time}: The cabin reaches its temperature at this time.
target {temp}: The temperature the climate control aims for.
time windows: Number of preferred charging time slots, shown as 'label: number'.
timers: Number of charging timers, shown as 'label: number'.
Review undone: Message and log entry: the 'reviewed' mark was removed.
review undone: Log entry: the 'reviewed' mark was removed.
Silent since {date} ({hours} h): Data check: no data arrived from the car since this date, for this many hours.
